long_biography.plain_text:
Iason Hellenic Shipping grew from an agricultural-export business created by Alexandros Petrakis. Chartering vessels for that trade supplied the expertise for a move into shipowning, and the company was established in 1984 to manage the resulting fleet. The business remains centred on dry-bulk carriage and full commercial, technical and crew management.

Themistocles Petrakis took responsibility for commercial development after an early brokerage role in London. During thirteen years at the head of Iason's commercial division, he built relationships with charterers and widened the management platform. As chief executive, he has continued fleet investment while retaining direct ownership of the group's UK shipping company.
